summary: Iteration 4 — verified 3 new features on Pritha Cabinet CRM. Backend: 17/17 pytest passes for new + regression (login admin/emp, list users admin-only, list customers, list sales; PATCH /api/admin/users/{username} covers non-admin=403, unknown=404, empty patch=400, short pw=400, blank display_name=400, display_name persists, password update actually rotates login credential and is restored; POST /api/customers by employee forces assigned_to=self with status=pending, ignores employee-supplied assigned_to override, duplicate phone→409, end-to-end create-customer-then-sale works). Frontend (mobile 390x844): (a) Dashboard for admin AND emp7 shows the Pritha Cabinet logo (assets/images/pritha-logo.jpg) + brand name 'Pritha Cabinet' + 'CUSTOMER RELATIONSHIP' tagline row above the greeting — confirmed for both roles. (b) Admin More → 'Manage team' opens /team screen, 7 employees listed, tapping emp7 opens the edit sheet with display_name + password fields, save triggers 'Updated Employee 7' toast at the bottom, list reflects the change; then restored back to 'Employee 7'. (c) Employee 7 opened Punch a sale from Progress, switched to 'New customer' mode, filled name+phone+amount+product, submitted; new customer 'TESTUI PunchNew' (5558013261) appeared in the Calls list AND the leaderboard for emp7 updated to '2 sales · ₹2,354' — proves both /api/customers and /api/sales fired in the same submit. Duplicate-phone UI path is present in code (PunchSaleModal L69-77) and fully verified at the backend layer (409 test passes). No blocking issues.
action_items: None blocking. Optional: verify emp7 password stays 'Emp@2026' in memory/test_credentials.md — the test restores it programmatically at the end of test_password_update_changes_login (asserted with a fresh login).

Optional UX: after a successful punch-sale-new-customer submit, the sheet closes and the parent screen (Progress) refreshes; consider a subtle success toast so the user knows the customer was also saved (not just the sale).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py::admin_update_user (L493-515) — clean: display_name trim/length guard, password ≥4 rule, and 400 when both fields None. Uses find_one_and update-via-set, returns fresh doc. Good.
server.py::create_customer (L529-556) — enforces employee cannot override assigned_to (L540-541), unique phone_norm index prevents race duplicates, status defaults to 'pending'. Matches spec.

team.tsx — EditEmployeeModal builds patch with only-changed fields; if display_name unchanged AND password blank → 'Nothing to update' error prevents an empty PATCH (matches the backend 400 rule). Good UX guard.

PunchSaleModal.tsx (L64-78) — creates customer first, then sale; on 409 shows 'This phone number already exists' and short-circuits without punching a sale. Correct ordering — no orphaned sale on duplicate.
index.tsx brandLogo — is loaded from require('../../assets/images/pritha-logo.jpg') so it is bundled. Confirmed rendering as in web preview.

To rerun iteration-4 alone: `EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=$(grep EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env|cut -d= -f2) pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration4.py -v`.
